narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are three tiles on one wall and four on the other, so seven tiles!
<bookmark mark='edge'/>That counts only the tiles along two walls.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The middle of the floor is still bare, so seven cannot be enough.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 3 + 4 = 7 tiles; a single row along each wall glows while the middle of the floor stays empty; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Divide each wall by the tile side, then multiply the two counts to get the number of tiles.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. A balcony is twenty five feet by thirty five feet. Find the highest common factor and count the tiles.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the line divide each wall by the tile side, then multiply the two counts appears; then a new balcony 25 ft by 35 ft appears with two empty boxes
